text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, doxycycline hyclate 100 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 479 capsules at 16.1 capsules per day (29.8 days on hand). Corvale General holds 449 capsules at 14.9 capsules per day (30.1 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 50 capsules at 2.7 capsules per day (18.7 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include doxycycline hyclate as of 2026-10-21. A registered plant for a current label is Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3007938603), last inspected 2023-03-24 with a VAI classification.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately 30 days of supply at East and General, but Lakeside has only 18.7 days. No FDA shortage exists, so allocation restrictions are not in effect. Purchasing from available manufacturers not on the shortage list is the primary mitigation.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders with AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc. for all three sites; Pharmacy Director approves purchase.
2. Buyer places orders with Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. as secondary source; Pharmacy Director approves purchase.
3. Buyer places orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. as tertiary source; Pharmacy Director approves purchase.
4. Buyer monitors daily usage at Lakeside and triggers expedited shipping if days on hand fall below 14; Pharmacy Director approves expedite.
5. Buyer verifies receipt and allocation across sites within 48 hours of delivery; Pharmacy Director confirms distribution.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
